# ECB Technologies

> Electronics shop in Nairobi CBD, Kenya, selling genuine laptops, smartphones, printers, gaming gear and accessories, with prices in Kenyan shillings (KSh).

Based in Nairobi; sells to individuals, students, businesses and institutions across Kenya. Every product page shows the current price in KSh, stock status and specifications. Contact: +254717040531 (call or WhatsApp), ecbtechnologies001@gmail.com.

- [Where to buy laptops and phones in Nairobi](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/laptop-shop-nairobi.md)
  - ECB Technologies is a laptop and phone shop at Techmart Iconic Business Plaza, 3rd floor, room T12, Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD, open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm (closed Sunday). It lists 349 laptops from KSh 16,000 to KSh 324,000 (median KSh 52,000) and 672 products in all, with prices in KSh on every product page. Orders are delivered by rider within Nairobi and by courier to all 47 counties, or picked up free at the shop. Figures as of 25 November 2026. (https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/laptop-shop-nairobi)
  - Where can I buy a laptop in Nairobi CBD? ECB Technologies, Techmart Iconic Business Plaza, 3rd floor, room T12, Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD. It lists 349 laptops from KSh 16,000; open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm. (https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/laptop-shop-nairobi#faq)
